answer: Histories are stored in fable, checked in willow, and vine shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 5 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 4797 identities would post 1944 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
